sn22.136:1.2: “Burning chaff” (_kukkūla_) is the name of a hell ([mn130:21.1]()). Some later Buddhists argued that this description meant that all conditioned things were nothing but scorching pain with no pleasure at all, against which the Theravadins cited a series of Sutta texts ([kv2.8]()). Compare [sn22.60]().
